name: The Middle East
overview: Scripture reveals that the Middle East will be a focal point of intense conflict and divine intervention in the last days. Daniel 12:1 speaks of a time of unprecedented trouble involving God's people, with Michael standing as their protector. Zechariah 14:12 describes a severe judgment upon those who oppose Jerusalem, highlighting the severity of the coming war. Matthew 24:1 reminds us of the significance of the temple in these events, underscoring the spiritual and prophetic importance of this region.
